title: Fourier expansion on the binary cube
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Then $f(x)=\sum_{\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n}\widehat f(\gamma)\chi_\gamma(x)$, where $\widehat f(\gamma)$ is the uniform average of $f(z)\chi_\gamma(z)$ over $z\in\mathbb F_2^n$ and $\chi_\gamma$ is the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
